verdict.rationale: Poke is documented as an AI assistant that lives in messaging channels (Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, RCS). The pack shows no official desktop app, OS-level shortcuts, or screen access. The 'Send to Poke' right-click flow is an example of using the programmatic API, a developer building block rather than a first-party desktop app, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen
